documents.name: harbor.md
documents.content:
# Operations reference

## Beacon Color

The lighthouse beacon color is amber.

## Harbor Depth

The east harbor channel depth is 8 meters.

## Ferry Time

The morning ferry departs at 06:40.

## Dock Number

Research boats use dock 12.

## Harbor Radio

The harbor master monitors channel 74.

# Operations reference

## Soil Ph

The greenhouse soil target is pH 6.2.

## Watering Hour

Seedlings are watered at 05:15.

## Orchid Temp

The orchid room temperature is 21 degrees Celsius.

## Compost Bin

Citrus compost goes in the blue bin.

## Garden Voltage

The grow lights use 24 volts DC.

# Operations reference

## Vaccine Temp

Vaccine stock is stored at 4 degrees Celsius.

## Clinic Room

Blood samples are logged in room 3.

## Clinic Window

The clinic lab closes at 18:30.

## Clinic Alarm

The backup alarm code is 4821.

## Clinic Generator

The clinic generator runs on propane.

documents.name: workshop.md
documents.content:
# Operations reference

## Tool Torque

Spindle bolts are tightened to 32 newton meters.

## Lathe Oil

The lathe gearbox uses ISO VG 68 oil.

## Safety Glasses

Welding requires shade 11 lenses.

## Workshop Filter

Replace the extraction filter every 90 days.

## Workshop Switch

The emergency stop is beside the south door.

documents.name: archive.md
documents.content:
# Operations reference

## Archive Shelf

Maps from 1912 are stored on shelf B7.

## Archive Humidity

Archive storage humidity is 45 percent.

## Archive Hours

The archive is closed on Mondays.

## Archive Gloves

Use nitrile gloves for photographs.

## Archive Permit

Form AR-9 grants reading-room access.

The archive box contains 1912 labeled cards.

documents.name: station.md
documents.content:
# Operations reference

## Station Platform

The northbound local leaves from platform 6.

## Station Bicycle

Park bicycles in the west courtyard rack.

## Station Lost

Lost items are held for 30 days.

## Station Water

Potable water is available beside platform 2.

## Station Gate

Gate C opens first on Sundays.
